answer: 5. open-286599256fa6 yes, inference tickets are transient. a trouble ticket is kind of a work order to fix something. if we start running into recurrent problems we'll explore that. ideas are just notes that lead to intentions. they're not important once the intention is set down. same with questions. once they're answered, only the answer is important most of the time. if we need more than the answer, we don't need the question, we need the why. the only reason to have the question is to deduce the why. if we have the answer and the why, nothing else matters. harbor_master is intended to be the machine/device that reports on the state of all the tickets. could easily be either a cairn thing or a codemother thing or it's own device. a reporting only device if so. why a cairn thing? because a task ticket shows up there too. so does a trouble ticket, a fixit ticket, not inference tickets tho.
